paragraphs.text: The Knights of Kjeldor are the combined knightly orders of Kjeldor during the Ice Age of Dominaria .

Some of the Knights of Kjeldor accompanied Jaeuhl Carthalion as he led Kaysa , Laina , and the Fyndhorn elves into Yavimaya . These included Zaraya , Kailo , Onala , Gregor , Xian , and Jaeuhl Carthalion himself.
The Order of the Sacred Torch
The Order of the White Shield
The Kjeldoran Skyknights , mounted on Aesthirs
The Kjeldoran orders were dissolved when Kjeldor itself merged with the Balduvians and became New Argive .
